purpose: Make READY mean exact owner-valid, machine-dispatchable work with a registered executor contract, immutable subject identity, durable idempotency/fencing semantics and current Topology-005 retirement boundaries.

rules: executor_id must resolve through SECOND-SHIFT-EXECUTOR-REGISTRY-001.json and the registered kind must equal executor_kind.
Delegations never contain an arbitrary shell command, arbitrary workflow path, arbitrary model/tool instruction or arbitrary executable URL.
GIT_SHA subject values are exact 40-hex commits; artifact/snapshot subjects are exact cryptographic digests.
timeout_seconds must not exceed the registered executor maximum.
heartbeat_seconds must be shorter than the applicable claim heartbeat SLA.
idempotency_scope is stable for the intended side effect and unique across distinct mutation identities.
A01_REGISTERED_QUALIFICATION additionally binds qualification_id, workstream_id, exact subject SHA and current A-01 policy admission.
AGENT_REGISTERED_TASK binds a versioned task-contract reference and a registered tool policy; natural-language scope alone is not executable authority.

owner_control_binding.rule: Every active peer owner lane binds valid_for_control_head to the exact live canonical owner branch head immediately before claim.

admission_rules: Owner path must resolve through the topology selected by CURRENT-AUTHORITY or an explicit shared-infrastructure route.
valid_for_control_head must equal the live owner branch head at claim time.
READY requires a registered executor contract in addition to a concrete completion delta and stop condition.
CANDIDATE may remain non-dispatchable while an executor contract, dependency or authority prerequisite is being prepared.
A changed owner head invalidates READY/CLAIMED work until reconciled.
Only one mutation-capable claim is live per active peer lane.
State-changing execution requires durable idempotency and a current fencing token.
Human, author, private-data, external-authority and native-platform boundaries remain fail-closed.
A-01 work requires its registered exact-subject gateway; Second Shift never bypasses A-01 policy.
PROSE is COMPLETE_RETIRED_TERMINAL under Topology-005 and has no executor, claim, repair, telemetry, successor or inherited execution domain.
Any genuinely open use/integration of preserved Prose capability is BOOK-owned work with BOOK executor/evidence identity.
DOCUMENTS receives no Prose execution authority.
PROGRAMMING remains a non-peer work program until explicit topology admission; only explicitly routed CORE custody/provenance support may use CORE Second Shift execution.
completion_rule: Terminalize and release the exact claim transactionally, preserve evidence, re-read authority, then bind at most one dependency-valid same-owner successor as READY only when its registered executor contract is complete. Otherwise bind it as CANDIDATE or preserve eight-rung exhaustion.

empty_lane_rule.rule: No active peer lane is IDLE solely because its current executor is blocked; dependency-valid CANDIDATE preparation remains possible when authorized.

authority_boundary: Execution plumbing never grants product, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, native, publication, promotion or production authority.
